kind: small paired pilot: full conversations, two arms, one attempt (official tau2 grade); alltools retrieval
question: Is there enough promise that harness v1 improves gpt-5-mini over the standard agent under alltools to justify a larger confirmation run?
arms_note: 'baseline' is the benchmark's standard agent: tau2's LLMAgent, unmodified (tests/test_alltools_compat.py). 'harness_v1' is bench/harness.py with spec {}. Dependency search is OFF. The arm is named 'baseline' so the batch tooling pairs it as the reference arm.
selection_rule: The first 5 of H002's 10 tasks in H001 hash order (the same 5 as H003), fixed before any H005 run and not chosen by outcomes. They cover different workflows: account opening/closing (069), product recommendation with a card and savings account (058), rebate eligibility and a card application (023), declined cards at an ATM (089), and a lost/stolen card (077).
arm_order_rule: one (task, arm pair) group per task, both arms back to back; the first arm alternates by task in the listed order (baseline first on tasks 1, 3, 5; harness_v1 first on tasks 2, 4). Times first: baseline 3, harness_v1 2.
settings_note: H004's settings with retrieval_config alltools: gpt-5-mini medium reasoning, 16,384 output tokens (incl. reasoning), gpt-5.2 low customer, seed 300, max_steps 200. Identical in both arms. alltools = tau2's default for banking_knowledge (KB_search_bm25, KB_search_dense with OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, shell).

infrastructure.shared_by_both_arms: bench/sandbox_policy.py: shell reads denied outside the knowledge base (home, /tmp, system temp, both repositories); sandboxes under /private/var/tmp/aep_kb_sandboxes; the shell's environment reduced to an allow-list (no credentials). Validated: research/alltools/containment_check.json (canaries; every probe denied, knowledge base readable). Each trace records sandbox_policy and a shell_audit.
infrastructure.offline_validation: tests/test_alltools_compat.py, tests/test_alltools_e2e.py (scripted, fake embeddings, conclusive answer independence in both arms); reference controls under alltools 30/30 same reward, 0 hard-check firings (research/harness_v1/reference_controls_alltools.json)

preflight.what: research/alltools/dense_check.py: the first real-embedding check. Embeds the 698 documents once (cached and reused by the batch), then 45 task-agnostic title queries: dense top-3 hit rate must be at least 0.80 (BM25's is reported beside it).
preflight.rule: H005 conversations start only if the dense check passes; if it fails, dense retrieval is investigated first and no conversation is run.
preflight.approval: approved together with the pilot in one message; its spend counts toward the $5.00 total

outcomes.primary: official tau2 reward per conversation (10), and paired outcome per task (improved / regressed / both pass / both fail / incomplete)
supporting: which tasks any gain comes from (one task twice is one task)

retrieval, from each conversation's model view with bench/kb_evidence.py: documents observed full / partial / discovered, by tool (KB_search_bm25, KB_search_dense, shell); required-document recall at the 'full' level and at 'full or partial'
missing documents among failures (an association, not a cause)
progress with bench/metrics.py buckets: discoverable writes, discoverable reads, base writes, customer actions; and agent read calls, attempted writes, successful writes
harness activity: held / released / withheld by check, tools offered
cost per conversation (upper bound and cache-aware), cost per pass, latency, agent input and output tokens, embedding spend
shell use and shell_audit flags per arm; any flag is inspected before results are reported

safety_audit.scope: blind to arm, H002 codebook: every conversation with an executed write, both arms, plus both conversations of every task whose pass/fail differs (with 10 conversations this is expected to be most of them)
safety_audit.procedure: as H004: one first review for all scoped conversations; an independent second review for every flagged conversation plus the 4 unflagged ones with the most writes; disputes adjudicated blind before unblinding; any rule-dependent count reported under both readings
safety_audit.counts: confirmed violating actions and conversations with at least one, per arm; ambiguous separately

outcomes.not_evidence: 5 development tasks x 1 attempt, one model: descriptive screening only. Not a performance estimate, not held-out, not leaderboard-comparable.

forecast_usd.basis: H004: v1 $0.213/conversation (upper bound, BM25, medium); H003 standard $0.166; alltools assumed $0.20-0.35 per conversation; dense preflight about $0.05-0.10.
forecast_usd.expected: about 2.00-3.60 for 10 conversations plus the preflight (upper bound; a forecast, not a bound)

execution.budget_handling: per_run_cap_usd ($1.00) is both the reservation from the total and that conversation's enforced budget. $4.70 is the enforced conversation total and $0.30 the enforced preflight cap: $5.00 together. A run starts only while the unreserved total covers $1.00; with 2 workers each start needs $1.00 unreserved beside one other $1.00 reservation, so if mean spend exceeds about $0.33 per conversation, the last run may not start.
execution.incomplete: interrupted runs keep their outcome and are not rerun; unfunded runs are not_run, never failures, never replaced; a task with either arm unfinished is an incomplete pair, listed and excluded from the paired counts; the batch is labelled COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE.
execution.interruption: operator-stopped runs are journaled with their spend and rerun, disclosed
execution.approval: runs only after Nidhi approves in chat with the amount: 'run H005 with $5.00' (covers the dense preflight within the $5.00)

no_retries: no conversation is repeated; every scheduled run is reported
supersedes: the 40-conversation H005 design frozen at 89e3490 (never run). Reduced before any spend, on cost grounds, to a descriptive pilot: fewer conversations, the same comparison and settings.
interpretation: DESCRIPTIVE SCREENING, not a test of improvement: 5 paired conversations cannot establish a benefit, and no pass-count gate is applied. Pre-stated heuristic for the next spending decision only: plan a larger confirmation if harness_v1 is at least level with baseline on passes AND (it passes more tasks, OR its pooled discoverable-write progress from bench/metrics.py is higher by at least 0.10) AND it has no more conversations with a confirmed policy violation. Otherwise stop spending on this comparison and report. Either way the pilot is reported in full.
budget_split: $5.00 approved in total = at most $0.30 for the dense preflight (its own cap, research/alltools/dense_check.py) + $4.70 for the 10 conversations (bench/batch.py enforces budget_usd_total). Commands: dense_check.py --approved-usd 0.30; then bench.batch --approved-usd 4.70.
